# json-render source build

The two tarballs in this directory were built from the official
`vercel-labs/json-render` repository at commit:

`3ad381881194e7011ad3ccd6d668033495a06c29`

Both packages report version `0.21.0` and were built together so the
experimental Jev composer in `@json-render/core` stays aligned with the React
renderer. The revision is pinned because `experimental_composeSpec` and
`experimental_createEvaluator` were not published at the time this project was
implemented.
